findings.issue: The `entry.move.name` vs `entry.move.move.name` nesting bug took ~17 turns to diagnose: the stack trace was misread twice and a debug patch was applied to dead code for two turns.
findings.suggestion: Read the innermost app frame of the stack first, and when instrumentation produces no output, check that the patch actually landed before re-running the request.

findings.issue: Never consulted the provided .agents/skills/hono guidance, docs, or web search; relied on training knowledge plus reading node_modules sources.
findings.suggestion: Read the available skill files and release notes before implementing against a framework's current stable release.

findings.issue: pkill -f 'node app/server.mjs|node server.mjs' matched the invoking shell and killed it (exit 143), wasting a turn on process management.
findings.suggestion: Track server PIDs in files (as it did later with /tmp/app.pid) and kill by PID, or use a narrower pattern that can't match the shell command line.

findings.issue: Debug logging was inserted at the wrong call site, so the added console.error never fired and two more turns were spent on a hypothesis the patch never tested.
findings.suggestion: Verify the edit landed (grep the injected string) before re-running the failing request.

findings.issue: Ran a node script importing './api-does-not-exist.mjs' and reading nonexistent data files — a guaranteed-failure call adding no information.
findings.suggestion: Skip throwaway commands that cannot succeed; write the minimal repro directly.

findings.issue: Attempted to use Python PIL twice despite it being unavailable in the environment.
findings.suggestion: After the first ModuleNotFoundError, drop the approach (the read tool on images already worked).

findings.issue: Stray write tool call to /home/pi/apps/placeholder failed with EACCES.
findings.suggestion: Verify the destination path before issuing a write.

findings.issue: Several turns of estimating sprite/card pixel sizes by eye without image tooling; produced no code change.
findings.suggestion: Either install a small PNG-reading dep to measure precisely, or accept the token-driven sizes once the comparison is 'close enough'.

summary: A well-planned, nearly linear session: full spec/test/design reconnaissance before coding, a first implementation that mostly worked, one root-cause fix to reach 54/54, and thorough verification including browser screenshots against all reference designs and a full-suite re-run after the final edit. The main blemish is a 17-turn, somewhat flailing debug of a self-inflicted variable-nesting bug, plus a handful of avoidable tool failures and no use of the provided framework skills/docs.
